episodes.synopsis: Akko is finally matriculating at Luna Nova Witchcraft Academy! But she faces expulsion if she doesn't get to the entrance ceremony.
episodes.title: Starting Over

episodes.synopsis: Akko is excited when her classes finally start, but learning magic turns out to be boring. Worse, her classmates make fun of her for admiring Chariot.
episodes.title: Pappiliodya

episodes.synopsis: Akko starts flying lessons using a broom that Professor Ursula gives her, but she struggles -- and the Academy's broom relay race is coming up.
episodes.title: Don't Stop Me Now

episodes.synopsis: Akko, Lotte and Sucy receive detention for stealing a tart. They're also forbidden to go into town, even though Lotte is dying to go to a book event.
episodes.title: Night Fall

episodes.synopsis: After getting into a fight in class, Akko and Amanda have detention together: They must clean the New Moon Tower, where they find dragons.
episodes.title: Pact of the Dragon

episodes.synopsis: Unable to master even basic transformation magic, Akko is relegated to her room and must miss the welcome party for a VIP and his handsome son.
episodes.title: The Fountain

episodes.synopsis: Akko gets serious about studying but can't master the basics, even with Professor Ursula's help. She flubs test after test, risking her enrollment.
episodes.title: Orange Submariner

episodes.synopsis: After drinking an experimental brew, Sucy falls into a deep sleep and won't wake up. To save her, Lotte sends Akko into Sucy's mushroom-filled dream.
episodes.title: Akko's Adventure in Sucyworld

episodes.synopsis: On a trip off school grounds, Akko breaks the no-magic rule and raises a skeleton from the dead. When it runs off, she and her friends must chase it.
episodes.title: Undead Travelogue

episodes.synopsis: Akko and her friends invite themselves to Andrew's party, where Sucy releases a magical bee whose sting ignites a deep infatuation in its victims.
episodes.title: Bee Affection

episodes.synopsis: Desperate to know if she can ever overcome her magical difficulties to be like Shiny Chariot, Akko uses the blue moon's power to search for an answer.
episodes.title: Blue Moon

episodes.synopsis: Akko hopes to win the same award at the upcoming school magic festival that Shiny Chariot won years ago, but Diana looks to be the prime candidate.
episodes.title: What You Will

episodes.synopsis: As the festival draws nearer, Akko has a novel idea for spicing up the sacrificial ceremony. But she'll need a lot of help to pull it off.
episodes.title: Samhain Magic Festival

episodes.synopsis: The school's fairies go on strike and cut off Luna Nova's source of magic. A new teacher arrives and proposes a non-traditional mechanical solution.
episodes.title: New Age Magic

episodes.synopsis: Akko agrees to let Professor Croix conduct a magical analysis of the Shiny Rod. Professor Ursula senses danger and rushes to Croix's tower.
episodes.title: Chariot of Fire

episodes.synopsis: While visiting Lotte’s parents, Akko wakes up to find the town's residents struck by a mysterious ailment that can only be cured by a witch.
episodes.title: Pohjola's Ordeal

episodes.synopsis: Akko's quest to find Shiny Chariot leads her to seek a special chalice hidden at Andrew's prestigious all-boys school. She and Amanda sneak in.
episodes.title: Amanda O'Neill and the Holy Grail

episodes.synopsis: As the annual Wild Hunt approaches, Akko tries to help her taciturn classmate Constanze, with mixed results. Professor Croix hatches a plot.
episodes.title: Stanship Take Off!

episodes.synopsis: A family situation forces Diana to quit Luna Nova and head home, shocking the school. Refusing to accept the loss of her "rival," Akko follows her.
episodes.title: Cavendish

episodes.synopsis: Diana enters the Cavendish family sanctuary. Akko and Andrew overhear Daryl gloating about trapping Diana to prevent her completing the ceremony.
episodes.title: Intellect and Sensibility

episodes.synopsis: Croix tells Akko the sixth word is related to the wagandea tree, but Ursula forbids her from going. Andrew hears about a mind-altering new app.
episodes.title: Discipline

episodes.synopsis: Ursula tells Akko the seventh word although she herself doesn't know its meaning. She's about to reveal everything when a message arrives from Andrew.
episodes.title: Things We Said Today

episodes.synopsis: Akko disappears after she learns the truth, and her friends are worried. Ursula recalls her past with Croix before Diana confronts her.
episodes.title: Yesterday

episodes.synopsis: Ursula confronts Croix, but fails to prevent her carrying out her plan. Akko, Diana and their friends are swept into the Arcturus Forest.
episodes.title: A Road to Arcturus

episodes.synopsis: Everyone seems powerless to stop the magical missile. But Akko believes otherwise, and her friends the "New Nine Witches" follow her lead.
episodes.title: Changing at the Edge of the World
